supporting_news.title: Explained: Why gold investors should tone down expectations as yellow metal plunges to a 1-year low
supporting_news.summary: Gold has fallen more than 30% from its January record high, with rising oil prices, inflation concerns and expectations of further Fed rate hikes adding to pressure. Analysts remain cautious about a near-term recovery, even as major banks retain bullish forecasts for 2027.

supporting_news.title: Rupee ends little changed as traders stay cautious despite oil, dollar drop
supporting_news.summary: The Indian rupee closed at 94.90 per dollar, trimming its earlier advances. Despite lower oil prices and a softening dollar, the rupee struggled to gain ground as traders remained wary ahead of the impending US midterm elections. Additionally, the Reserve Bank of India's increased dollar forward position suggests a possible dollar-buying approach. Overall, market sentiment reflects caution as global factors continue to influence local currency trends.

supporting_news.title: Goldman Sachs expects Bank of England to raise rates again in February
supporting_news.summary: Goldman Sachs has revised its outlook on the Bank of England's interest rates, now predicting a possible quarter-point rise in November's monetary policy meeting. This would be the first increase since 2023, influenced by climbing energy costs and robust economic growth. Although immediate policy shifts are unlikely, the Bank will vigilantly observe inflation risks, maintaining rates at 4.25% through mid-next year.

supporting_news.title: US midterm elections set to begin: Can Trump’s likely defeat sparkle Sensex, Nifty? Here’s what analysts say
supporting_news.summary: The November 3 US midterm elections could reshape control of Congress, with analysts anticipating potential Republican losses. A divided government may heighten market volatility, although historical annualised returns remain largely unaffected. For Indian investors, the key concerns are the dollar, US bond yields, crude oil prices and foreign fund flows amid an already challenging market environment.
